is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluated Anopheles gambiae s.s. (Kisumu and Kdrkis strains).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study evaluated the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) kdr mutation.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No field population genotype counts or frequencies are reported; only experimental groups of laboratory-reared mosquito lines were tested.

african_field_population.evidence: The study exclusively used laboratory colony strains (Kisumu, originally isolated in Kenya in 1975, and Kdrkis, an introgressed strain) maintained and tested at IRD in Montpellier, France. No field-caught mosquitoes were evaluated.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical laboratory study measuring mosquito behavior in wind tunnel assays.

sub_country_location.evidence: No African field collection sites were involved.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field mosquito collection window exists as only laboratory colony strains were used.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Primary laboratory study using long-established colony lines.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary files are required to evaluate eligibility.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the behavioral cost and overdominance of the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) mutation in Anopheles gambiae s.s. using laboratory colony strains (Kisumu and Kdrkis) in wind tunnel experiments in Montpellier, France. Because only laboratory colony strains were used and no field-collected mosquitoes were genotyped, the paper is ineligible.
exclusion_reasons: Does not study an African field population (uses laboratory colony strains Kisumu and Kdrkis).
Does not report extractable genotype data for field populations.
